=== EMAIL to primary@example.com
Subject: p.stonn has noticed a change you made on the council’s website
Provenance: You received this at primary@example.com because this address manages, or shares access to, a p.stonn account that schedules a visitor parking permit. p.stonn is a free, unofficial scheduler for City of Stonnington visitor parking permits.

Someone on your account put a new number plate on your visitor permit using the City of Stonnington ePermits site: AAA111

Changing number plates on the City of Stonnington website works just fine with p.stonn. There is also an easier way.

If you would like, we can help you set up a guest pass for your visitors, a quick picker for regos on your phone, or put number plate changes on a schedule.

Open p.stonn:
https://p.stonn.org

Contact us for assistance:

p.stonn will not send you this note again.
